final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor supplied no new admissible evidence and largely narrowed its position by reinterpreting the same record. That reinterpretation is not enough to move this case to compliant_with_caveats. A caveated position would be sufficient only if the caveat described an already-satisfied policy-bounded condition evidenced in the record. Here, the policy makes current documentation or approved mitigation/risk acceptance a certification predicate, and the available evidence still does not show that predicate has been met. Aggregate readiness, absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents, prior approval context, and public governance principles remain supportive background evidence, but they do not cure the missing current-release documentation or approved mitigation requirement. The unresolved concern from the initial audit therefore remains dispositive.
remaining_concerns: No admissible evidence shows the current release documentation has been updated to reflect the latest evaluation results.
No admissible evidence shows the school admissions advising regression has been disclosed as a material limitation for the named launch use case.
No admissible evidence shows approved mitigation or formal risk acceptance covering the current subgroup regression before launch.
Prior approval predates the current retrieval configuration change and current eval batch, so it cannot satisfy the current-release certification predicate.
The release-thread monitoring comment is not reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, or approved disclosure language.
